messages:
maria_p: Quick sync — NovaCloud confirmed the joint webinar slot for May 15 (30m). They want a live demo of our Dedicated routing -> NovaCloud HW path, plus a short marketplace listing preview. Are we good on a fallback if live demo flakes?

devon_h: I booked a 30m speaker prep call with NovaCloud for May 8. Can we aim to have a dry-run with the demo env by May 10?

olivia_g: For the demo fallback: we should prepare a recorded run and a local canned response server. If the KV-cache warmup is slow, switch to the recorded clip. (I can produce the clip once we have the run-of-show.)

samir_k: Noted. Also need to confirm which model version we serve during the live demo — production pin or a quantized variant for latency? NovaCloud asked for lowest-latency config.

maria_p: Good call. Preference from their ops: show the dedicated path with quantized 8-bit variant for throughput, but include a quick slide comparing prod vs quantized output quality. Olivia, can you benchmark 8-bit vs prod on the demo sequence by Tue?

olivia_g: Yes — I'll run perf + quality checks on the scripted prompts. ETA Tue EOD.

marc_t: Swag/shipping note: NovaCloud will co-brand a small box of stickers + one tech guide. We need to split shipping labels for the partner booth and our booth staff pickup. Deadline to confirm artwork to printer: May 1.

maria_p: Who owns artwork? Marc? Also need copy for the marketplace blurb and co-marketing one-liner for the registration page.

marc_t: I got the art. I'll push mockups by Fri. For copy — drafting a 2-line co-headline + 1-paragraph blurb. Will drop in drive and post link here.

samir_k: AV checklist: confirm microphone on NovaCloud laptop, test HDMI passthrough for our demo machine, and have a network fallback (cellular hotspot) on standby. Also let's request a stage ethernet drop reserved.

devon_h: Adding to run-of-show draft:
```
00:00–00:02 Intro — hosts (Maria + NovaCloud rep)
00:02–00:08 Product overview + marketplace blurb (Marc)
00:08–00:18 Live demo (Olivia) — primary path (dedicated GPU -> NovaCloud)
00:18–00:23 Backup recorded demo if live fails
00:23–00:28 Q&A + CTA (signup + marketplace link)
00:28–00:30 Close + swag pickup instructions
```

maria_p: Perfect. Olivia, for the live demo, add a simple metric overlay (latency, tokens/s) so folks see the economics. Samir, can you script the metric output so it's human-readable?

samir_k: Yep — will generate a tiny CLI wrapper that prints:
```
Latency: 120ms | Tokens/s: 85 | Model: rwd-llm-q8
```
I'll have it ready for the dry-run.

olivia_g: Also requesting a small prompt set for regression checks from Product so we can gate quality before the demo. Maria, can you pull 6 representative prompts?

maria_p: On it. I'll share in this thread by Wed.

marc_t: Shipping logistics — who is handling the swag crate to partner booth? I can coordinate label splits if someone passes the final list.

devon_h: I'll own pickup and handoff day-of. Need the final addressing list by May 6.

maria_p: Action items summary (:clipboard:):
- Olivia: perf + quality bench on quantized demo prompts (due Tue EOD)
- Samir: metric CLI + demo wrapper (due May 9)
- Marc: swag mockups + copy drop (due Fri)
- Devon: pickup & handoff logistics; needs final addresses by May 6
- Maria: collect 6 prompts + coordinate dry-run timing with NovaCloud (I own scheduling)

deploy-bot: Reminder: room reservation confirmed for May 10 dry-run at 2:00pm in Conf B.

maria_p: Sweet. If no objections, I'll lock these timelines and ping NovaCloud for the May 8 speaker prep + May 10 dry-run. Thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread so we have the audit trail. :rocket:
